mercari_new_inquiry_trigger.description: Runs for each new inquiry in Mercari. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

mercari_new_or_updated_inquiry_trigger.description: Runs for each inquiry added or changed in Mercari. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
